thread:
maria.g: Kicking off a windowed enable for catalog entry `open-7b-lite-2026-03` in the us-west-2 change window (15:00-16:00 PT). planning phased traffic + fallback ordering.

deploybot: Starting staged_enable for model=open-7b-lite-2026-03, catalog_id=cl-09f8, strategy=windowed. Phase 1 -> 10% traffic -> us-west-2.

alex.r: Thx. What's the fallback ladder for this model? we should avoid routing to the 6b if latency spikes.

maria.g: Fallback order set to [open-7b-quant, open-7b-2bit, open-6b]. goal: prefer quantized 7b variant before dropping to 6b.

jamal: Heads up: last time we saw evictions when a single AZ got noisy during a rollout. Can we pin to specific instance groups/avoid bursting beyond pool capacity?

maria.g: Good call. Adding capacity guardrails and an eviction TTL on fallback entries. Config snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  phases:
    - percent: 10
      region: us-west-2
      instance_groups: [ig-w-1, ig-w-2]
      fallback_order: [open-7b-quant, open-7b-2bit, open-6b]
      fallback_ttl: 5m
      monitor: [p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate]
      rollback_thresholds:
        error_rate: 0.01
        p95_increase: 0.25
```

olivia.k: Oncall, can you watch the error_rate and tail logs for the first 20 minutes? we'll escalate if error_rate > 1% or p95 jumps >25%. @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: ack. I'll be watching dashboards and will ping here on any anomalies. Have alert runbooks ready.

deploybot: Phase 1 applied: 10% traffic routed to open-7b-lite-2026-03 in us-west-2. Canary checks started.

alex.r: Running quick smoke: a few prompts against the canary look good. latency ~40ms p50, p95 ~120ms. No obvious regressions in outputs.

jamal: Noted minor increase in kv cache miss rate at the canary nodes, expected during warm-up. Keep an eye.

deploybot: Canary checks: p50_latency=38ms, p95_latency=125ms, error_rate=0.003. All checks within thresholds.

maria.g: OK, proceeding to phase 2 will be manual after 30m observation. Plan: 30% next with same fallback order and keep eviction TTL. If metrics stable for 30m we move to 60% then full.

olivia.k: Also adding a transient pin for internal routes (studio/*) to keep traffic off the variant while we watch. Will open a short-lived pin config.

sre-oncall: Alert configured: if error_rate > 0.01 OR p95 rises by 25% sustained for 5m -> auto rollback. I patched the automation to prefer rollback-only (no auto-escalate) during the change window.

deploybot: Note: rollback hook available at /deploys/cl-09f8/rollback.

alex.r: If we hit a noisy AZ again, we should temporarily adjust routing to other AZs before rollback. Is that an option?

maria.g: Yes — smart routing policy enabled: prefer healthy AZs, but won't change fallback ordering. We'll try regional shift first, full rollback only if errors persist.

jamal: FYI I created an incident stub with the rollout notes and rollback criteria in case we need to accelerate communication.

maria.g: Thanks. If phase 2 looks good after 30m we'll document release notes: enable, fallback order, eviction TTL, rollback thresholds, and link to perf dashboards.

deploybot: Phase 1 complete. Observing for 30m.

olivia.k: quick comment — capture a note that we temporarily disabled heavy caching optimizations for the canary group to avoid cache warm-up flapping. we'll re-enable after 2hrs.

sre-oncall: Observability ok so far. No alerts. standing by for the 30m mark.

maria.g: thanks all. I'll post an update in ~30m with go/no-go for phase 2. :white_check_mark:
